meta.purpose: Binary constraint system — every region either ALLOWS or BLOCKS each vision component, with explicit reasoning. No vagueness.
meta.rule: If you can't explain WHY in one sentence, the constraint isn't real.

cow.why: Flat grazing available (0.5-1 acre). Climate 3-28°C within Gir tolerance. Kosi water accessible.

sheep.why: Gaddi sheep are native to this exact region. Built for 5000-10000ft.

goats.why: Goats browse brush on slopes — terrain is an asset, not a limitation.

chickens.why: Warm coop in winter. Free-range in summer. Standard.

bees.why: Himalayan wildflowers Mar-Oct. Monsoon risk Jul-Sep manageable with hive placement.

largeFarming.why: 0.5-1 acre flat is enough for kitchen garden + fodder crops.

apples.why: 5500-6500ft is prime apple zone. Proven — Chaubatia Gardens near Ranikhet.

turmeric.why: Warm enough in summer (28°C). 9-month growing season sufficient.

organicFarming.why: Uttarakhand is India's first organic farming state. Government policy supports it.

shilajit.why: Uttarakhand is the source region. Uttarkashi/Chamoli accessible.

mushroomLab.why: Climate suitable. Indoor lab不受 weather. Starlink provides internet.

cow.why: Same climate band as Ranikhet. Gentle terrain suits cattle.

bees.why: Orange blossoms = excellent forage. Better than most regions.

largeFarming.why: Gentlest terrain of all options. 0.5-1 acre flat easily farmed.

oranges.why: Orange orchards PROVE citrus thrives here. Signature crop.

turmeric.why: Deep fertile soil. Warm enough in summer.

cow.why: Slightly colder but manageable with shed. Ridge has enough flat for small herd.

chickens.why: Warm coop needed Nov-Feb. Otherwise fine.

bees.why: Season slightly shorter due to cold but viable.

largeFarming.why: Narrow ridge = limited flat land. Can't run 0.5+ acre garden easily.

turmeric.why: Marginal — cold winters limit it but summer warmth helps.

tea.why: Kausani tea gardens exist — proof of concept.

cow.why: Winter drops to -1°C — too cold for Gir cows without expensive heated shelter. Steep slopes = no flat grazing. Borewell not viable = water access limited.

sheep.why: Sheep handle cold and steep terrain. Built for high altitude.

goats.why: Goats handle steep. But limited flat browsing area.

chickens.why: Winter drops to -1°C with snow. Chickens need heated coop. Snow blocks free-ranging Nov-Feb. Adds significant cost and complexity.

bees.why: Snow cover Dec-Feb blocks foraging completely. 7-month growing season too short for meaningful honey production.

largeFarming.why: 0.2-0.5 acres flat per 5 acres. Steep slopes everywhere. Thin soil. Can't run meaningful crops.

apples.why: 7400ft — prime apple zone. Tehri Garhwal is apple country.

turmeric.why: Winter drops below 0°C. Turmeric rhizomes freeze. 7-month season too short for 8-10 month crop.

organicFarming.why: Uttarakhand policy. But limited flat land means limited scale.

mushroomLab.why: Indoor lab不受 weather. But power (borewell not viable) makes it harder.

kasol-parvati.name: Kasol / Parvati Valley
kasol-parvati.stateRestrictions: HP Section 118 — outsiders cannot purchase agricultural land

cow.why: Steep V-shaped valley = 0.2-0.5 acres flat per 5 acres. Cows need 0.5+ acre flat grazing. Not enough space.

sheep.why: Gaddi sheep are native to HP. Steep terrain is their natural habitat.

goats.why: Goats browse steep slopes. Natural fit.

chickens.why: Valley floor has enough flat for coop. But limited free-range space.

bees.why: Alpine flowers. Heavy monsoon risk Jul-Sep but manageable.

largeFarming.why: 0.2-0.5 acres flat per 5 acres. Steep V-valley = can't run crops. Only valley floor farming possible.

apples.why: 5180ft — apples grow on slopes. Valley floor too low but mid-slopes work.

turmeric.why: Heavy monsoon (2500mm) causes waterlogging. Turmeric needs well-drained soil. Slopes drain too fast for consistent moisture.

mushroomLab.why: Indoor lab. But borewell not viable — water from river needed.

propertyPurchase.why: HP Section 118 — outsiders CANNOT buy agricultural land in Himachal Pradesh. Must lease only.

decisionMatrix.description: For each vision component, which regions are binary ALLOW vs BLOCK

cow.blockReason: dhanaulti: too cold/steep/no water. kasol: too steep (0.2-0.5 acres flat).

sheep.blockReason: Sheep work everywhere — they're hill animals.

goats.blockReason: dhanaulti: too steep even for goats, extreme terrain.

chickens.blockReason: dhanaulti: -1°C winters, snow blocks free-ranging, heated coop needed.

bees.blockReason: dhanaulti: 7-month growing season too short. Snow blocks foraging Dec-Feb.

largeFarming.blockReason: kausani: narrow ridge. dhanaulti: steep slopes. kasol: V-valley. All <0.5 acres flat.

turmeric.blockReason: dhanaulti: winter below 0°C kills rhizomes. kasol: monsoon waterlogging.

organicFarming.blockReason: kasol: HP restrictions + limited flat land.

mushroomLab.blockReason: Indoor lab不受 weather. All regions viable.

propertyPurchase.blockReason: HP Section 118 — outsiders cannot buy agricultural land.
